registers.purpose: REG1 3.3V enabled; REG2 disabled; read existing 5202 default before changing an enabled regulator

registers.name: DCHG Pin Config
registers.purpose: REG1 push-pull, low when charging is prohibited

registers.name: DDSG Pin Config
registers.purpose: REG1 push-pull, low when discharge is prohibited

registers.name: Vcell Mode
registers.purpose: Real physical channels 1..7 and 16; VC8..15 shorted to VC7

registers.name: Enabled Protections A
registers.purpose: Only CUV and COV; SRP/SRN are tied to VSS, no current protection claim

registers.name: Enabled Protections B
registers.purpose: External thermistors are MCU inputs; no invented AFE temperature protection

registers.name: CHG FET Protections A
registers.purpose: Keep TI specified fast output mapping even though unused current protections are disabled separately

registers.name: DSG FET Protections A
registers.purpose: Keep TI specified fast output mapping; do not replace with 0x04

registers.name: CUV Threshold
registers.purpose: 30 x 50.6mV = 1.518V emergency backstop, not the normal operating lower limit

registers.name: CUV Delay
registers.purpose: 3.3ms x (28+2) = 99ms nominal; actual response qualification required

registers.name: COV Delay
registers.purpose: 99ms nominal; compare to 100ms datasheet characterization condition

registers.name: FET Options
registers.purpose: FET_CTRL_EN=1 required for digital fault outputs; SFET=0, no body diode override; no host FET-control dependency

registers.name: Chg Pump Control
registers.purpose: Charge pump disabled; CP1-BAT capacitor retained for safe factory-default startup

registers.name: Precharge Start Voltage
registers.purpose: No autonomous BQ precharge is configured for this candidate; low-voltage charging remains a normal system process. This setting neither requires external charging in normal use nor qualifies DC/DC startup from 0V

registers.name: Cell Open-Wire Check Time
registers.purpose: 1s diagnostic interval; no sub-50ms open-wire detection claim

registers.name: Balancing Configuration
registers.purpose: Disable internal automatic and host balancing; existing BW6101 handles group balancing

registers.name: Mfg Status Init
registers.purpose: FET_EN=1 enables autonomous digital fault state; PF_EN retained; no OTP write command

software_contract.note: All wiring/noise/latency/imbalance allocations require physical qualification. 80A is a screen, not an established current clamp. Any invalid condition revokes power permission.

startup_sequence: Hold MCU permit low, TIM1 MOE=0, both PWM outputs low, BUS PMOS disabled until all startup, measurement and protection gates qualify; no unqualified automatic PWM.

Check core and AFE rails. AFE supply is from the supercapacitor stack. From-0V measurement, driver bootstrap, minimum pulse and permit timing are unqualified; evaluate controlled current-limited charging through the existing bidirectional DC/DC with per-group monitoring and overvoltage protection. An external current-limited source is for assembly/bench commissioning only, not a daily-use requirement.

Identify exact IC, establish CRC communication, keep permission low during CONFIG_UPDATE. Write/verify little-endian data memory with checksum/length using TI protocol; preserve reserved bits where applicable.
Disable internal balancing and charge pump, configure physical cell map and COV/CUV before configuring healthy-high digital outputs. Read back every register and ManufacturingStatus.FET_EN.

Require NORMAL mode and prohibit sleep/slow measurement while armed. Require new complete scan, CRC valid, eight physical voltages plausible, cell sum agrees with independent total voltage ADC within its error budget; actual age remains within 50ms total shutdown budget.

Validate thermistors, current zero and calibrated gain, both analog comparator paths, TIM1 break latching and idle output levels before releasing permit. Inject soft/hard faults with a cell simulator before high power.

On bad CRC, stale scan, lost I2C, rail reset, UV/OV, thermal fault or break, latch MCU permit low and MOE=0. Recover only after valid new scans plus an explicit re-arm request; no automatic rearm after a protection event.
release_status: HOLD until native netlist, regulator startup, configuration readback, fault outputs, timing, calibration and energy path are qualified
